item.description: ### Fixed - **A Claude session started without Perch's hooks now says so, and cannot be replied to or stopped remotely.** Starting Claude Code with `--bare`, `--restricted`, or `--setting-sources` without `user` skips the settings file Perch's hooks live in. Perch showed such a session as an ordinary row that never changed, and it could not tell when the session was sitting at a permission prompt, where a reply approves the command and Stop denies it. The row now reads "no hooks" with the flag that caused it, and replies and Stop are refused for it. Start the session without that flag to get live state and replies back.
